properties.mobility_hazard: High — Steep crater rim slopes (>20°) & large boulder fields
properties.science_note: Middle Noachian highland massif (>3.7 Ga); oldest exposed crustal bedrock.

properties.mobility_hazard: Moderate — Fractured volcanic plains & sharp basaltic ridges
properties.science_note: Early Hesperian volcanic unit; critical for radiometric age calibration.

properties.mobility_hazard: Low-Moderate — Layered sedimentary benches & eroded scarps
properties.science_note: Hesperian-Noachian transition; prime target for ancient lakebed biosignatures.

properties.mobility_hazard: Moderate — Wind-sculpted ridges (yardangs) & loose sand ripples
properties.science_note: Late Hesperian transition unit; records Mars's shift from wet to arid climate.

properties.mobility_hazard: Low — Relatively flat basin floor; watch for fine dust traps
properties.science_note: Late Hesperian lowland unit; smooth corridor ideal for rapid EVA traverses.
